_description: Transcribed elastic (C) and gradient-elastic (D) constants of cubic crystals. Form II of Mindlin's theory, D_ijmkln with eta_ijk = d_k eps_ij. Units: C in eV/A^3, D and a_i in eV/A. Transcribed by hand from the PDFs and checked on 2026-10-22; every digit re-checked against the PDF text on 2026-10-30 (analysis/check_transcriptions.py). Provenance of every entry: provenance.csv.
_a_convention: a1..a11 as in Lazar, Agiasofitou & Boehlke (2022), eq. (40); conversion Voigt -> a by their eq. (60).

lazar2022.source: Lazar, Agiasofitou, Boehlke, Continuum Mech. Thermodyn. 34:107-136 (2022), Tables 1 and 2
lazar2022.provenance: published (computed in Admal et al. 2017 / Po et al. 2019 with the 2NN MEAM potential of Lee et al. 2001, OpenKIM MD_111291751625_001)
lazar2022.use_rule: Table 1 is the input; a_i are recomputed with eq. (60). Table 2 agrees with eq. (60)(Table 1) to rounding (max 7e-5). Do not copy Table 5 (Cu lambda_7 misprint) or Table 3 values; recompute.
lazar2022.note: Lazar & Po, J. Mater. Sci.: Mater. Theory 8:5 (2024), Table 1, repeats C and a_table2 digit by digit (checked 2026-10-22). Stored as dataset lazarpo2024.

po2019.source: Po, Admal, Lazar, Materials Theory 3:3 (2019), Table 1
po2019.provenance: published; Cu EAM: EAM potential of Mendelev et al. (2008) according to their text (their KIM reference MO_106969701023_001 is titled 'FS potential for Al'); Cu and Al MEAM: Lee 2NN MEAM (same data as lazar2022, more digits for some entries). Full provenance: provenance.csv
po2019.use_rule: Same Voigt (non-normalized) notation and ordering as lazar2022 Table 1. Cu EAM is an independent third dataset (positive definite). Po et al. note possible artefacts of EAM gradient constants.

lazarpo2024.source: Lazar and Po, J. Mater. Sci.: Mater. Theory 8:5 (2024), Tables 1 and 2
lazarpo2024.provenance: published; same 2NN MEAM data as lazar2022 (their Table 1 cites Lazar et al. 2022). Transcribed from the rendered pages 23-24 and checked on 2026-10-26.
lazarpo2024.use_rule: Table 1 is not an independent dataset: it repeats lazar2022 C and a_table2 digit by digit. Recompute ell with eq. (107), ell^2 = S_ijkl D_ijmklm / 18; eq. (108) lacks a factor 1/18. The printed ell of Fe and W do not follow from eq. (107) and Table 1, while the printed ell/a do: slip in the ell column for Fe and W.
lazarpo2024.units: C in eV/A^3, a in eV/A, ell and lattice_a in A
